records.verificationNote: All hepatitis C DAAs on this plan carry PA flags: Epclusa, its sofosbuvir/velpatasvir generic, Harvoni and ledipasvir/sofosbuvir generic, Mavyret (Tier 2), Vosevi, Zepatier and Sovaldi (Tier 3). The sofosbuvir/velpatasvir generic is picked as the common product in the class at the same tier as Epclusa; it is not a brand-over-generic case, so boglActive is false. Ribavirin and Pegasys are outside this class. Listing rows read for this class: 18; alternatives shown 0 of 0 non-PA products (Tier 1/2 first); PA-flagged products listed in paRequired: 11.
